append.label: alignment files to append
append.help: Paths of the alignments to append to the input one, separated by spaces.
append.helpZh: 要追加到输入比对之后的比对文件路径，用空格分隔。

concat.label: alignment files to concatenate
concat.help: Paths of the alignments concatenated with the input one. Sequences are matched by name.
concat.helpZh: 与输入比对做拼接的比对文件路径，按序列名对齐；用空格分隔。

revcomp.label: sequence names
revcomp.help: Only these sequences are reverse-complemented. With no argument, the whole alignment is.
revcomp.helpZh: 只对这些序列做反向互补；不填则反向互补整个比对。

subset.label: sequence names
subset.help: Sequence names to keep, separated by spaces. Add --indices to give 0-based positions instead, or --regexp for patterns.
subset.helpZh: 要保留的序列名，用空格分隔；改用 --indices 可填 0 起的序号，改用 --regexp 可填正则。

subsites.label: site positions
subsites.help: 0-based site positions to keep, separated by spaces. Add --reverse to drop them instead.
subsites.helpZh: 要保留的位点位置（从 0 开始），用空格分隔；改用 --reverse 则删除这些位点。

templates.name: Strip gaps then summarize
templates.description: Drop gap-dominated sequences and gap-containing sites, then print the alignment statistics. Statistics end the chain.
templates.descriptionZh: 先删掉缺口过多的序列，再删掉含缺口的位点，最后打印比对统计。统计命令会消费比对，因此是链条的终点。

templates.name: Pairwise distance matrix
templates.description: Kimura 2-parameter distances computed on gap-free sites. Prints a matrix instead of an alignment, so it ends a chain.
templates.descriptionZh: 在无缺口的位点上计算 K2P 两两距离。输出的是距离矩阵而非比对，因此是链条的终点。

templates.name: Alignment heatmap
templates.description: Render the alignment as a PNG, one row per sequence and one pixel per character.
templates.descriptionZh: 把比对渲染成 PNG：每行一条序列，每个字符一个像素。

templates.name: Shorten names and export Phylip
templates.nameZh: 截短序列名并导出 Phylip
templates.description: Trim sequence names to 12 characters and write the alignment out in Phylip format.
templates.descriptionZh: 把序列名截断到 12 个字符，并以 Phylip 格式输出比对。

templates.name: Deduplicate and export Nexus
templates.description: Remove sequences that are byte-identical, then convert the alignment to Nexus.
templates.descriptionZh: 删除序列内容完全重复的序列，再把比对转换为 Nexus 格式。
